summary: First test round for Sketch platform. Ran 29 backend integration tests covering auth (email+OTP), profiles, reels, products, cart/wishlist, full mock-payment checkout with escrow, seller shipping/delivery, complete custom-request workflow (submit→admin review→estimate→advance pay→start→deliver→complete), company mgmt, studio product/reel upload + admin moderation, admin overview/users, RBAC, support tickets, notifications, search. 28/29 passed (96.5%). One backend bug (500 on reel comment creation due to ObjectId serialization). Frontend smoke test: landing/auth pages load, login as customer works, discover/reels/marketplace/cart render, RBAC redirect works (customer→/admin redirects to /). data-testids present on auth form elements.

critical.issue: Returns 500 — the comment dict returned still contains raw ObjectId in `user_id` (built with `oid(user['id'])` on line 603). FastAPI cannot JSON-serialize ObjectId. Backend log shows: TypeError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable. Fix: convert to str, e.g. `"user_id": user["id"]` (or run through `pub()` before returning).

minor.issue: server.py line 1398 sets allow_origins to FRONTEND_URL env or localhost:3000 — production preview domain (creator-studio-518.preview.emergentagent.com) may only work because the frontend and API share origin. If cross-origin needed, add explicit origin.

Every failed attempt resets locked_until to now+15m (line 148). So a legit user can be locked out for 15 min after just crossing the 5 threshold; also `locked_until` is only checked, never cleared after expiry via TTL — minor UX concern.

Fetches ALL orders (up to 10000) and builds order_map in memory — will not scale. Also `payment.ref_id` is stored as string while order lookup by _id would need ObjectId conversion; the current order_map keys on `str(o['_id'])` which does match, so functionally OK, but O(N) memory.

issues: When seed/uploaded reel has invalid media_url (e.g. 'http://x/img.png' or broken external URLs), only broken-image alt text renders on a black background — no fallback image or skeleton state. Consider a placeholder for failed media loads.

action_items: Fix POST /api/reels/{reel_id}/comments 500: return `pub(comment)` or convert `user_id` to str before returning (line 603-606 server.py).
Optionally: add graceful image error fallback in reels/product image components.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1417 lines — starts pushing the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers per domain (auth, products, orders, custom_requests, admin).

Multiple endpoints return raw `comment`/`review`/`estimate` dicts with ObjectId fields inside instead of piping through `pub()` (see /reels/{id}/comments — already broken; /products/{id}/reviews and /custom-requests estimate work only because they were built with strings/uuids). Standardize on `pub()` for all responses.
GET /api/analytics/creator loads all orders and payments into memory (up to 10000 each). Add proper aggregation pipeline.
Login attempt lockout resets locked_until on EVERY failed attempt — user can never unlock via cooldown; only DB TTL/deletion clears it. Should only set locked_until once count>=5.
cr_creator_check uses `str(cr.get('target_id')) != user['id']` — target_id is a string stored in DB, works, but inconsistent with other collections that store ObjectId.
/api/upload has no MIME validation; accepts any binary up to 200MB. Consider whitelisting image/video content-types.
test_credentials: All from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all valid and working
seed_data_creation: Test suite created a TEST_widget product and TEST_reel reel via meera and had admin approve them (both appear in discover). Also created OTP user (otp_test_*@example.com) and TEST_sup_*@x.com support account via super_admin. Multiple TEST_ prefixed items linger — cleanup not implemented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~9s with pytest-xdist. Only known failure is POST /api/reels/{id}/comments (ObjectId serialization). Frontend loads and integrates correctly with backend; auth cookies (httpOnly, secure, samesite=none) confirmed working across preview domain. Notifications badge, avatar, and role-based navigation render. RBAC: customer accessing /admin redirects to /. Seed data has been amended with TEST_ items — feel free to clean if needed.
rca_of_the_issue: POST /api/reels/{reel_id}/comments (server.py:597-606) builds a comment dict with `user_id: oid(user['id'])` — an ObjectId — then returns it directly. FastAPI's default JSON encoder cannot serialize bson.ObjectId → 500. Reproduction: any authenticated POST with text body triggers it. Fix: either return through the `pub()` helper (which converts ObjectId→str) or build with `str(user['id'])` from the start.
